idea-plugin.name: DSH Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Links JetBrains IDEs to a local DeepSeek Harness process, without any DSH-side plugin.
  • The DSH Chat tool window embeds the DeepSeek Harness web client in the IDE and signs the browser-session cookie DSH expects, so the chat runs inside the IDE with no other plugin.
  • Each project opened here becomes its own DSH session: the plugin reuses the project's most recent session over DSH's HTTP API and creates one when the project has none.
  • Publishes the live workspace — every open project root, the active file with its caret position and selection, and all open editor tabs — through a descriptor file and a token-protected loopback bridge, so DSH sees a multi-project window and can open files in the IDE.
  • Copies the workspace context to the clipboard, and reports its own status.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.6
  • A Changes toggle in the chat panel's toolbar shows and hides the changes panel.
  • A turn's diff opens by itself, with a Keep / Revert notification, in the window that owns the workspace.
  • Revert a whole file or a single hunk; a file edited since the turn is refused rather than half-reverted.
  • Turns published while the IDE was closed are mentioned on the next start.
